description: Before paying or trusting an address on Base or BNB Chain, get ChainWard's verdict on it (the `verdict` field): a machine label pay / hold / unknown, a human text (Pay, Hold, Inactive, No track record or Couldn't check), the one reason it rests on, and its limits. The flags under it are the evidence. Pass chain: 'bsc' for a BNB Chain address (default 'base'). On Base, also the EAS attestation (uid + explorer link) when ChainWard has published one, so the result is verifiable on-chain (BNB Chain reports are not attested yet). Read from on-chain behavior only: Pay means nothing was found against paying, not a guarantee. If the address has no report yet, say so and point to the free check at https://chainward.ai (https://chainward.ai/?chain=bsc for BNB Chain).

chain.description: Chain the address is on: 'base' (default) or 'bsc' (BNB Chain)
